column6: QWP bullet said every non-45° input gives elliptical light; input along either axis passes unchanged. Added that case.
Said the additive-constant ambiguity "is physical", contradicting the rest of the file; now "has no physical consequence".
At least one factor grows or decays exponentially ignored the all-zero case (linear solutions); added "unless all are zero".
Cut bullet "higher-Q cavity stores more energy for the same input": at resonance it does (U = QP/ω₀), so the belief is not false. 3 bullets remain.
TM modes have all three field components while TE have zero Ez or Hz garbled; now TM has Hz = 0, TE has Ez = 0.
Said the lowest mode needs only a half-wave along the longest axis; it needs the two longest. Matches new misconception bullet.
Lowest frequency set by the largest dimension changed to "two largest dimensions".
At cutoff the guide wavelength cannot fit is false for TM modes with p = 0; scoped it to TE₁₀ and the guide's lowest cutoff.
Q formula missing 2π factor (energy lost per cycle).
Same missing 2π, and "power dissipated per cycle" corrected to energy.
θ_c opens toward 90° contradicted the next sentence (max is arccos(1/n)); removed "toward 90°".
Garbled stem "can primarily be emitted" restored to "can only be emitted".
Plot J₁ and J₁′ beside each row fails for the TM₀₁ row (uses J₀); now "the relevant J_n or J_n′".
Nonsense cutoff formula jₙₘ = (λc/2πa)(ωc/ω) replaced with f_c = c·x/(2πa).
Stem and explanation called Thomson scattering a quantum result; it is classical, reproduced by QED at low energy.
Garbled stem "is expected to have" restored to "must have".
Garbled stem "that is expected to each be measured" restored to "that must each be measured".
Only analytic maps, and only in 2D overstated: anti-analytic maps also work, and 3D rigid motions and scalings keep Laplace's equation. Reworded.
Questions came after Explainer; moved Questions block before Explainer, content unchanged.

Bessel functions of integer and half-integer order (half-integer belongs to spherical problems) conflicted with the new integer-order bullet; now "integer order when the domain spans the full circle".
D follows from free charge alone only when symmetry fixes its direction too absolute (also true whenever curl P = 0); softened to "mainly".
Answer option and explanation blamed pulse spreading on differing phase velocities; it is group-velocity dispersion (matches the new bullet). Changed to group velocities.
Said group velocity is always ≤ c; it can exceed c in anomalous dispersion. Now says the signal front never outruns c.
Density written l = ε₀(E × B)/c² (missing r ×, spurious 1/c²); now l = ε₀ r × (E × B).
Spurious /c² in l = r × g; "carries Lℓ per photon" corrected to ℓℏ.
Stem claimed relative magnitudes and angles of E and B are frame-independent; only relations like E² > c²B² or E ⟂ B are. Reworded.
The angle between E and B is a relativistic invariant is false; now "whether E and B are perpendicular is the same in every frame".
Exercise attributed k = ω/c to Faraday's law; Faraday gives B = (kE₀/ω)cos(...), and Ampère-Maxwell fixes k = ω/c.
Garbled stem ("this match was already measured from astronomical observations") restored; explanation credited Rømer with good accuracy; now Rømer estimate plus Fizeau and Foucault lab measurements.
Formula "N extra polarizers in steps of 90°/N pass (I₀/2)cos^(2N)(90°/N)" gives 0 for the three-polarizer case; N must count steps, not inserted polarizers. Reworded.
Garbled stem "in most directions" restored to "in all directions".
Garbled stem "hardly anything ... is rotating" restored to "nothing ... is rotating".
Garbled stem "requires that primarily" restored to "requires only that".
g written (ε₀/c²)(E × B), and pressure "equal to energy density divided by c²"; now g = ε₀(E × B), g = u/c, pressure on absorber = u.
